justification: 50 events/day is derived from the synthetic temporal_events.csv (220 events spanning ~4.4 trading days at 15-min intervals). This is conservative relative to real-world news feed rates (Bloomberg/Reuters generate 500-2000 headlines/day per terminal). For a dedicated financial news verifier monitoring 50-100 tickers, 50 events/day is a reasonable dispatch rate. The carry-cost surface covers 0.1%-100% frequency range for sensitivity.
